<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 5:16">Ex. R. s. 5</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="Q01167"><he>פָּנוּי</he></cite>; a. e.

senses.gloss: that which is easily crushed, brittle shell, husk.
units: Orl. III, 7, a. fr. אגוזי פ׳ nuts with brittle shells, crack-nuts.

Pesik. R. s. 11 האגוז יש בו ג׳ מינים אגוזי פ׳ וכ׳ there are three kinds of nuts: soft-shell nuts, middling nuts &c.; של פ׳ שניפרך מעצמו the perekh nut which bursts open of itself; כך הוא ישראל … מעצמם אלו של פ׳ so are the Israelites: those among them who do good of their own accord are the crack-nuts; Yalk. Cant. 992.—Pl. פְּרָכִים, פְּרָכִין.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 13b:5">R. Hash. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>עשויין פ׳ פ׳</he> they (the peas) are husked as you need them.

senses.gloss: pl. as ab. [crushers,] bars of a grate (through which the poking is done).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 12:3">Kel. XII, 3</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 2:10">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. II, 10</cite>.
